synth.notes:
Sprites are 3x3 cells; one of {mirror axis (wall), pieces} is selected (hole pixels fill 0, else transparent).
Actions 1-4 move the selected thing by 3 (axis horizontal only); action 5 cycles axis -> pieces -> axis.
Reflections (colour 4, holes fill 4 over empty) mirror every piece across the axis centre; targets are static.
After state = layered render then re-extraction: wall/piece/reflection as 4-connected visible components named by (x,y), targets cropped to visible cells.
Unconfirmed: blocking rules, cycle order past the first piece, actions 6/7, wall name offset (= count of non-wall 0-components).
